title: Privacy Policy
content:
Privacy Policy for GoEdu

At GoEdu, accessible from https://goedu.ac/, one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors. This Privacy Policy document contains types of information that is collected and recorded by GoEdu and how we use it.

If you have additional questions or require more information about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us.

Log Files

GoEdu follows a standard procedure of using log files. These files log visitors when they visit websites. All hosting companies do this and a part of hosting services’ analytics. The information collected by log files include internet protocol (IP) addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamp, referring/exit pages, and possibly the number of clicks. These are not linked to any information that is personally identifiable. The purpose of the information is for analyzing trends, administering the site, tracking users’ movement on the website, and gathering demographic information. Our Privacy Policy was created with the help of the Privacy Policy Generator and the Privacy Policy Generator.

Cookies and Web Beacons

Like any other website, GoEdu uses ‘cookies’. These cookies are used to store information including visitors’ preferences, and the pages on the website that the visitor accessed or visited. The information is used to optimize the users’ experience by customizing our web page content based on visitors’ browser type and/or other information.

For more general information on cookies, please read the “What Are Cookies” article on Cookie Consent website.

Google DoubleClick DART Cookie

Google is one of a third-party vendor on our site. It also uses cookies, known as DART cookies, to serve ads to our site visitors based upon their visit to www.website.com and other sites on the internet. However, visitors may choose to decline the use of DART cookies by visiting the Google ad and content network Privacy Policy at the following URL – https://policies.google.com/technologies/ads

Privacy Policies

You may consult this list to find the Privacy Policy for each of the advertising partners of GoEdu.

Third-party ad servers or ad networks uses technologies like cookies, JavaScript, or Web Beacons that are used in their respective advertisements and links that appear on GoEdu, which are sent directly to users’ browser. They automatically receive your IP address when this occurs. These technologies are used to measure the effectiveness of their advertising campaigns and/or to personalize the advertising content that you see on websites that you visit.

Note that GoEdu has no access to or control over these cookies that are used by third-party advertisers.

Third Party Privacy Policies

GoEdu’s Privacy Policy does not apply to other advertisers or websites. Thus, we are advising you to consult the respective Privacy Policies of these third-party ad servers for more detailed information. It may include their practices and instructions about how to opt-out of certain options.

You can choose to disable cookies through your individual browser options. To know more detailed information about cookie management with specific web browsers, it can be found at the browsers’ respective websites. What Are Cookies?

Children’s Information

Another part of our priority is adding protection for children while using the internet. We encourage parents and guardians to observe, participate in, and/or monitor and guide their online activity.

GoEdu does not knowingly collect any Personal Identifiable Information from children under the age of 13. If you think that your child provided this kind of information on our website, we strongly encourage you to contact us immediately and we will do our best efforts to promptly remove such information from our records.

Online Privacy Policy Only

This Privacy Policy applies only to our online activities and is valid for visitors to our website with regards to the information that they shared and/or collect in GoEdu. This policy is not applicable to any information collected offline or via channels other than this website.

Consent

By using our website, you hereby consent to our Privacy Policy and agree to its Terms and Conditions.

title: Refund Policy
content:
Refund policy

Since the Website offers online courses and non-tangible, irrevocable goods and services, we do not provide refunds after the purchase, which you acknowledge prior to purchasing any course or digital products or services on the website.

We do have some courses that are accessible for learning for free, but require payment for certificates. For any other courses, learners may preview the free lessons to decide whether they will purchase the course or not.
In case the purchased course can not be accessed, or has technical issues that the GoEdu team can not resolve, GoEdu will substitute the course that has issue with a new one of similar prices.

Contacting us

title: Accreditation of GoEdu Online Course Platform
content:
Accreditation of GoEdu Online Course Platform

GoEdu Online Course Platform is proud to announce its accreditation by the Global Education Accrediting Commission (GEAC), underscoring our dedication to delivering exceptional online educational experiences that align with international standards.

Our accreditation from GEAC extends from 2025 to 2032, subject to periodic evaluations that confirm ongoing adherence to GEAC’s rigorous criteria for educational excellence.


About Global Education Accrediting Commission (GEAC)

The Global Education Accrediting Commission is an internationally recognized accrediting organization committed to promoting high standards and accountability in education globally. GEAC accreditation signifies that an institution consistently meets and maintains stringent standards of quality and effectiveness.

Benefits of GEAC Accreditation for GoEdu

Through GEAC accreditation, GoEdu:

  • Reaffirms our commitment to educational excellence and global best practices.
  • Undergoes regular, comprehensive assessments to continuously enhance course quality and delivery.
  • Provides assurance to our learners, educators, and partners about the high quality and credibility of our courses and educational programs.

Accreditation Duration and Compliance

GoEdu’s accreditation is effective from 2025 to 2032. Throughout this period, GoEdu will participate in interim evaluations conducted by GEAC to ensure ongoing compliance with their accreditation standards. These evaluations support continuous improvement and guarantee sustained educational quality and organizational integrity.

Accreditation Evaluator

Arian Marxaney, a distinguished evaluator appointed by GEAC, supervised the accreditation evaluation process for GoEdu, ensuring impartiality, meticulousness, and adherence to established standards.

GoEdu remains committed to maintaining its accreditation by continuously elevating our educational offerings and complying with GEAC’s rigorous standards.

title: User Guidelines
content:
Learner Guidelines

Your Complete Guide
to Learning on GoEdu

Everything you need to register, enroll, learn, complete courses, and earn your verified certificate at your own pace.

Step 1

Registering Your Account

Create your free GoEdu account in minutes. Your name is used on certificates, so make sure it is correct before submitting.

1

Open Registration Page

Go to goedu.ac/authentication and select the Sign-up / Register tab.

2

Enter Full Name

Use your real name exactly as you want it to appear on your certificate.

3

Add Email and Phone

Provide an active email address and phone number for account verification and password recovery.

4

Create Password

Create a strong password and confirm it in the second password field.

5

Agree and Submit

Read the terms and privacy policy, tick the agreement box if shown, and click Sign Up.

6

Verify Account

Check your email or SMS for the verification link or OTP. Also, check the spam/junk folder if the message is not in your inbox.

Step 2

Logging In to Your Account

Access your dashboard and all enrolled courses from any device.

1

Visit the Login Page

Go to goedu.ac/authentication or click Login from the top navigation.

2

Enter Credentials

Use your registered email address or username and password.

3

Reset If Needed

If you forget your password, click Forgot Password and follow the reset instructions.

4

Open Dashboard

After logging in, go to your dashboard to browse courses, track progress, and manage certificates.

Step 3

Enrolling in a Course

Find the right course and get started instantly, whether it is paid or free.

1

Browse or Search

Select Courses from the navigation or use the search bar to find your preferred course.

2

Review Details

Check the overview, lessons, quizzes, assignments, course duration, instructor, and certificate information.

3

Check Price

Paid courses show a price and a Buy Now button. Free courses may show ৳0 but still require enrollment.

4

Complete Enrollment

For paid courses, complete checkout through available payment methods. For free courses, enroll directly.

5

Start Learning

After enrollment, the course appears in your dashboard or My Courses section.

Step 4

Making Progress in a Course

Courses are divided into lessons, quizzes, and activities. Complete them step by step.

1

Follow Course Order

Start from the first lesson and continue through the course structure in sequence.

2

Watch Videos

Complete the video lessons and use the provided learning materials where available. Watch the complete video to unlock the next lesson.

3

Complete Quizzes

Attempt quizzes and assessments required by the course.

4

Track Progress

Use the dashboard progress indicator to see completed lessons and remaining activities.

5

Use Discussions

Participate in course forums or discussions to ask questions and learn from others.

Step 5

Completing a Course

Finish all required activities so GoEdu can mark your course as completed.

1

Finish Lessons

Watch all course lessons and complete the learning materials assigned to each section.

2

Submit Activities

Complete quizzes, assignments, and self-assessments required for course completion.

3

Meet Passing Score

If the course has a passing score, retake or review assessments until you meet the requirement.

4

Confirm Completion

Once all requirements are complete, the course status should update as completed in your dashboard.

Step 6

Getting and Sharing Certificates

After course completion, download your certificate and share the verifiable link with others.

1

Open Certificates

Go to the course page from your dashboard and click on the View Certificate button.

2

Download PDF

Click Download Certificate to save a PDF copy for printing or job applications.

3

Copy Verification Link

Use the certificate link to allow employers, institutions, or others to verify your achievement online.

4

Share Socially

Share the certificate on LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, or your CV/portfolio using the certificate link.

Pro Tips

Tips for a Successful Learning Experience

Use these habits to make your GoEdu learning journey smoother and more effective.

Use the Forum

Ask questions, share insights, and learn from instructors and fellow learners.

Plan a Routine

Set a weekly study target and use your dashboard progress to stay on track.

Learn on Mobile

Use mobile access to continue learning whenever you have time.

Update Profile

Keep your name and contact details correct so certificates display accurate information.

Ready to Start Learning?

Explore GoEdu courses and begin building practical skills with verified certificates.

Explore All Courses

title: About Us
content:
GoEdu is an online course platform offering professional online self-paced courses in Bangladesh. GoEdu aims to contribute to developing personal and professional skills, abilities, and traits of individuals by offering online self-paced courses. GoEdu understands that it is tough for learners to only depend on their academic institutions to fully equip them for their careers and profession. GoEdu with its courses tries to create a bridge to cover the gap that lies between the latest industry requirements and the actual skills and knowledge of the professional people and adult learners. Since it is based in Bangladesh, GoEdu focuses on equipping the local professionals preferably with their own language.

GoEdu is also helping people develop the skills and knowledge necessary to create and run an online course in just a few clicks. It’s a modern and affordable way for anyone to earn a living doing what they love and is open to everyone.

Our Values

We believe in and, therefore, value instructor success because we know that if instructors succeed in helping learners learn new skills or knowledge effectively, our main stakeholders, the learners will automatically value the organization. We keep the learners in mind and ensure the best support to them so that they can effectively learn new knowledge, skills, and abilities through our platform.
